deviations.rationale: Codex descriptors preserve explicit-only invocation for workflows whose upstream frontmatter disables model invocation. Native metadata changes discovery registration, not the body or intent of the principles.

Review actual discovered skill/delegation paths rather than Cursor-only transcript conventions. Templates still separate judgment, tooling and divergent review; permission intent is read-only without assuming a host-specific Ask mode removes connector access.

Route authoring, questions, skill roots and active-project history through available tools; retain privacy boundaries and explicit evidence gaps. Help/setup become optional rather than mandatory configuration. Bot UI needs an explicitly configured service and secure secret entry, defaults to localhost, and uses authorized OS-specific Tailscale setup. Teach retains progressive visual explanation with a drawable fallback when image generation is absent. Skill/agent metadata identifiers are normalized for portable discovery.

Keep design alternatives, fan-out, rubric-based selection and review lenses, but resolve models and delegation through the runtime. Two inherited-model seats are an intentional default change; same-model or sequential results must not be labeled diverse-model or independent evidence.

Keep transcript checks scoped to a supplied active-project file, support spaces and portable timestamps, and avoid treating closed unmerged PRs as landed cleanup candidates. These are generally useful helper correctness fixes, not a new orchestration service.

Keep the parent chat as playbook runner and poteto-agent as a fresh scoped delegate. Resolve poteto-mode from the parent-supplied path or active package wrapper, not a Cursor-only global scan or highest-version installation. Remove host-specific background metadata; the actual host controls delegation.

Add one runtime resolver rather than host-specific workflow copies. Replace mandatory Cursor model rules and hard-coded providers with optional scoped JSON, inherited models, and validated host overrides. This deliberately changes model/default setup behavior, while preserving explicit requirements for genuinely independent or diverse-model execution.

These principle/workflow bodies retain upstream content; the changed paths add explicit OpenCode slash/autoinvoke metadata and the shared runtime pre-read. Do not infer model reasoning or every workflow semantic result from metadata/native loading tests.

Replace Cursor Task/model/private-state/loop assumptions with runtime roles, actual delegation or disclosed sequential passes, portable .pstack state, and available schedulers. Preserve phase goals, verification, and isolated writes. Active-session continuation cannot substitute for persistent wakeups; independently executed/model-diverse work remains a gap when the host lacks it.

Preserve upstream explicit invocation, goal restatement, read-only catch-up, action-item boundaries, word limit and factual visuals. Add portable discovery and runtime resolution; ketchup can use available plotting tools when visualize is absent, without starting an app or inventing screenshots.

upstreamCandidates.rationale: Portable timestamp parsing, space-safe paths and closed-unmerged PR cleanup classification are useful independently of additional host adapters.
Localhost defaults, secure secret entry and OS-specific authorized setup can improve the original integration without requiring the portable model system.

limitations: Native discovery and mock round trips prove loading/protocol expansion, not real-model reasoning or every workflow outcome.
Independent/multi-model review, persistent scheduling, cloud execution and external integrations require actual configured capabilities; reduced-independence fallbacks are disclosed.
Cursor GUI resolution and Windows junction behavior lack native GUI/Windows CI evidence; static portability checks are the declared coverage.
Automatic existing-scope native catalog startup remains unavailable because pinned CLIs write state; isolated version probes preserve requested user state.
